summary: Contango Silver & Gold Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Contango Lucky Shot Alaska, LLC, entered into a purchase agreement with Alaska Hardrock Inc. to acquire 100% ownership of the Lucky Shot project in Alaska. Total consideration is $16,074,000, comprising a $300k deposit, $1,709k cash at signing, $4.065k cash at closing expected by July 1, 2026, and a $10M promissory note bearing 5% interest compounded monthly. Principal repayments of $2M are due on the second and third anniversaries, with the balance due in 2030. The note is secured by the acquired assets, and the existing 2% NSR royalty was effectively terminated. Watch for regulatory clearance and risk-arb on closing timeline.
